tagline: Low-cost leisure airline operator serving underserved U.S. markets with focus on leisure travel demand
hero_kpi_rationale: Reflects core performance of the primary business, reaching $2.5 billion in 2025 with solid 4.3% growth amid difficult macro conditions, demonstrating resilience of the capacity growth and network expansion model.

kpis.name: Airline-only Operating Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated solely from airline operations, excluding ancillary activities.
kpis.description: Total airline revenue increased 4.3% year-over-year, reaching a record $2.5 billion in 2025.
kpis.signal: Solid growth despite a challenging macro environment

kpis.name: Unit cost per seat-kilometer excluding fuel
kpis.explanation: Operating cost per seat-kilometer, excluding fuel and special charges.
kpis.description: CASM excluding fuel and special items declined 6.1% in 2025, despite a 12.6% increase in capacity.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in operational efficiency despite 12.6% capacity growth

kpis.name: Number of routes served
kpis.explanation: Total number of air routes offered by the airline.
kpis.description: The number of routes was 540 as of December 31, 2025, slightly down from 541 in 2024.

kpis.name: Leisure destinations served
kpis.explanation: Number of primarily tourist destinations served.
kpis.description: The airline serves 34 leisure destinations, unchanged from 2024.

kpis.name: Active members of Allways Rewards program
kpis.explanation: Number of active members in the airline's loyalty program.
kpis.description: The airline had 21 million active members in its Allways Rewards program at the end of 2025.
kpis.signal: Large base of accumulated loyal customers

kpis.name: Operational fleet size
kpis.explanation: Total number of aircraft in operational service.
kpis.description: The operational fleet consisted of 123 aircraft as of December 31, 2025, down from 125 in 2024.
kpis.signal: Gradual reduction toward optimized operating structure

kpis.name: Co-branded credit card revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue received from the banking partner (Bank of America) for the co-branded credit card.
kpis.description: Co-branded card revenue from Bank of America reached $139.6 million in 2025, up 3.6%.
kpis.signal: Steady growth from a high-margin, recurring revenue stream

kpis.name: 737 MAX aircraft delivered and in service
kpis.explanation: Number of 737 MAX aircraft delivered and currently in service.
kpis.description: 16 737 MAX aircraft were delivered and in service in 2025, under a firm order of 50 aircraft.
kpis.signal: Gradual fleet modernization with improved fuel efficiency

kpis.name: Pilot retention bonus accrual
kpis.explanation: Cumulative amount accrued for pilot retention bonus, payable following ratification of the collective agreement.
kpis.description: Total accrual for pilot retention bonus was $235.9 million at the end of 2025 (including payroll taxes), with $89.8 million accrued in 2025.
kpis.signal: Critical investment to stabilize pilot crew and reduce attrition

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL data covering the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K filings).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 2.607 Bn USD for latest fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Dependence on regulatory approvals for Sun Country acquisition
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited as a closing condition ('customary closing conditions, including...regulatory reviews and approvals'). Timing is uncertain ('timing of regulatory approvals'). This risk is new and critical for the 2026 strategy.

risks.title: Fuel cost volatility without hedging
risks.score_rationale: Document explicitly states 'We have not sought to use financial derivative products to hedge our exposure to fuel price volatility, nor do we have any plans to do so'. Fuel is described as 'volatile' and 'subject to many economic and geopolitical factors we can neither control nor predict'.

risks.title: Potential delays in Boeing 737 MAX aircraft deliveries
risks.score_rationale: Document states that regulatory requirements 'could delay deliveries to us beyond management's current expectations' and that 'Further delays...will impact our ability to schedule additional growth'. Only 11 aircraft expected in 2026.

risks.title: Ongoing pilot union negotiations under mediation since 2023
risks.score_rationale: Collective agreement amendable since 2021, mediation ongoing since January 2023 ('mediation process...is continuing'). Major direct costs: $235.9M total accrual, $89.8M accrued in 2025. Critical operational impact on staffing.

risks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and wavering consumer confidence
risks.score_rationale: Document notes 'Consumer confidence vacillated during 2025' and 'macroeconomic uncertainty persists, driven by factors such as trade policies and tariffs'. Direct impact acknowledged: 'impacted our fares, load factors, and profitability'.

risks.title: Structural constraints on network expansion
risks.score_rationale: Document highlights that 'Our ability to add significant numbers of new routes has been constrained...by aircraft availability, flight crew staffing, high fuel costs, economic conditions'. The airline expects 'minimal' network growth in 2026.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning was found in the 2025 10-K.
